dialogues.speaker: Qingce Village Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Qingce Village Bulletin Board. You can find local news and notes from villagers posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The exquisite craftsmanship of Fanmu Carpenter's is second to none. Unfortunately, without someone to carry on the legacy, this carpentry's treasured craft is at risk of disappearing into the sands of time. We are looking for a young apprentice eager to learn the craft. Meals and lodging provided!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Anyone interested can talk to Master Lu... There's free tea!"
